There are \(10!\) possible matchings. A matching with exactly 9 correct pairs would have 9 fixed points in a permutation of 10 items. If 9 items are fixed, the remaining item must also be fixed, giving 10 fixed points, not 9. Thus there are 0 such matchings.

\[
P = \frac{0}{10!} = 0
\]

\boxed{0}
